t: Three instructions for dealing with people
a: خُذِ ٱلْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
p: Khudhi-l-ʿafwa wa'mur bi-l-ʿurfi wa aʿriḍ ʿani-l-jāhilīn.
m: Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
